end.summary:
Practised estimating a large collection using groups of ten.
Discussed that one group/box could represent ten objects.
Ananya gave estimates of 20 and 30 and counted by tens aloud.
The link between the number of boxes and the total remained unclear; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised grouping objects into tens and counting by tens with Ananya. Ananya asked questions about whether a box represented a group and tried examples such as 20 and 30. The mix-up between four boxes and forty was not corrected by the end. At home, draw a few boxes, place ten dots in each, and count the total together.
